content:
**Weapon Artisan** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk allows for all weapons to be repaired beyond their normal Durability.

| Rank | Description | Form ID | 
| 1 | You can repair any weapon to 130% of normal maximum condition. | 003D295F | 
| 2 | You can repair any weapon to 160% of normal maximum condition. | 003D2960 | 
| 3 | You can repair any weapon to 200% of normal maximum condition. | 003D2961 |
